verdict.rationale: A personal AI assistant could plausibly offer a programmatic API with UI parity, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API surface at all: the vendor says there are 'no new interfaces' beyond texting or calling, and a probe of its sitemap found no developer or API pages. With no documented API, parity with the UI cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
